articles.title: The World Cup Finally Arrives: 48 Teams, One Trophy, and a Summer of Soccer
articles.summary: The 2026 FIFA World Cup begins June 11 with Mexico vs. South Africa. This expanded tournament features 48 teams for the first time. The U.S. faces Paraguay on June 12. Matches air on Fox, FS1, and Tubi.

articles.title: Student Loan Shake-Up: July 1 Brings New Repayment Plans and Borrowing Caps
articles.summary: The One Big Beautiful Bill Act triggers major student loan changes on July 1. Over 7 million SAVE plan borrowers must switch plans. New graduate borrowing caps limit loans to $20,500 per year. Two new repayment options debut.

articles.title: Inflation Hits 4.2% as Gas Prices Surge—Rate Hikes Could Follow
articles.summary: U.S. consumer inflation rose 4.2% in May, a three-year high, driven by a 3.9% jump in energy costs. Gasoline is up 40% from last year to $4.15 per gallon. The Federal Reserve may raise interest rates in coming months.
